motivation: Saved fitted-field admission endpoints converge on 9/10 fixed continuous objectives but 0/10 original-discrete fresh objectives. Diagnose their difference before choosing another optimizer change
data_role: Already viewed outcome-informed development, read-only diagnosis of the same saved terminal states; not held-out validation
unchanged_state: Reconstruct original initial fixed sources, point/normal values, bilinear-center metric normalizers, prepared one-sided fields, incoming nonlinear prior and saved terminal poses. Apply no pose update, line search, tracker/prior/Schur commit or new trajectory fitting
identity: A source occurrence is target node, source node and original linear source-image pixel ID. The original rounded target pixel is separately reconstructed from initial reciprocal pairs; the fresh target pixel comes from terminal reciprocal pairs. Exact source point/normal equality is mandatory across shared identities
endpoints: Independently reconstruct the archived fixed continuous and original-discrete fresh endpoint systems. Separately evaluate the same continuous admission policy at the terminal pose, including its ordinary reselected center normalizers; this is a read-only third system, not continuation or proof that reselection alone caused any difference
gradient_bridge: In fixed order: remove fixed sources absent from fresh selection; on shared sources change Huber residual influence from continuous to original-target symmetric point-to-plane with continuous Jacobian held fixed; then change the Jacobian; change original rounded target to terminal rounded target; add fresh-only sources. Sum all five vectors exactly to fresh raw gradient minus fixed raw gradient. Incoming prior is identical and cancels
scope_of_components: Continuous-to-discrete residual influence includes the changed residual model and frozen engineering metric normalization, together with Huber clipping. Jacobian change includes projective field gradient versus rotating symmetric measured-normal differential. The ordered attribution is not unique, causal, or a physical outlier classification
diagnostic_subsets: Source subsets may contain fewer than200 occurrences solely for additive accounting; no intermediate system is solved and no admitted factor threshold is lowered. Original complete endpoint support, condition and increment guards and strict full-proposal1e-5m/1e-5rad convergence remain unchanged
scaling: Use the reciprocal square root of the complete fresh discrete system diagonal as one common engineering coordinate scale. Report component norms and signed projection fractions onto the scaled endpoint gradient difference. Fractions may be negative or exceed1 due to cancellation and are not variance, uncertainty or physical accuracy percentages. No raw mixed-unit gradient norm is used for ranking
independent_verification: Operational per-factor source-array joins and direct local-vector terms are checked against flattened global incidence Jacobians, dictionary identity sets and differences between six independently accumulated gradient stages. Separate relative-camera reciprocal selection, polynomial depth sampling, SVD normals, projector-based measured-normal derivatives, independent priors and spectral solves bind endpoint systems. Raw PNG hashes and one axial-Z /5000 conversion precede both constructions; decoded data remain shared
analytic_controls: Authored rows force all five nonzero terms, Huber tails, source removal/addition, retargeting and two moving endpoints. Identical and empty populations have zero differences and undefined projection fractions. Four receipt corruptions and four invalid inputs are rejected. Actual rendered surfaces and a nonzero prior check three endpoint systems and24 numerical gradient axes with correspondences frozen during differentiation
reporting: Retain all ten outcomes including the room200 support guard. Report exact shared, removed, added and retargeted source occurrences and identity digests; endpoint correction norms; reselected continuous convergence; five vector terms; maximum accounting error and signed projection ranges. Shared source counts across factors/windows are not new independent measurements
scope: No optimizer improvement, numeric real reference labels, physical pose-error score, new continuous trajectory, default/native adoption, vehicle integration or timing claim. Existing failed physical evidence and all previous manifests/sources stay unchanged
